summary.headline: Hermes and Planetary Significations
summary.text: Astrological significations of Hermes (Mercury), including education, letters, calculation, trade, games, divination, crafts, public offices, and varied professions according to zodiacal configurations and stellar combinations. The passage also describes bodily parts, substances, fruits, sect, color, and taste attributed to the preceding planet.
